reason: The plugin integrates local and GitHub-based Claude/Codex SKILL.md sources with DeepSeek Harness by parsing, normalizing, importing, and dynamically mounting skills through a CLI and SkillProvider.

summaries.zh: 将本地目录或 GitHub 中的 Claude/Codex SKILL.md 技能解析、归一化并导入或动态挂载到 DeepSeek Harness。
summaries.en: Parses and normalizes Claude/Codex SKILL.md files from local directories or GitHub, then imports or dynamically mounts them in DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Reads and scans local skill directories
Fetches skill files from GitHub repositories
Writes imported skills to local DSH skill directories
Dynamically mounts external or local skills into the DSH runtime
